name: Metabrawl
detailed_description:
After 1000 years, the mysterious portal to the metabrawl tournament opens once again. the masters of inu gather to crown the next champion of the metabrawl. The best fighters across the space come together to compete to reign victorious for the illustrious title of champion.

The meta-ryft, a world that connects all dimensions, and houses many powerful items, welcomes the fight. Witness an epic test of strength and skill where only the most powerful will be triumphant. many battles will be fought with one goal in mind: crowned king of the metabrawl.

Metabrawl delivers adrenaline-packed action and intense battles in a vibrant and dynamic world. Choose your fighter and step into the arena, where skill and strategy determine victory. Whether you’re taking on up to 3 opponents in chaotic brawls or going head-to-head in a classic 1v1 showdown, Metabrawl offers non-stop excitement.

Key Features:

  • Epic Brawls: Engage in high-energy battles, whether 1v3 or 1v1, in action-packed arenas designed for fast-paced combat.

  • Story Mode Exploration: Dive into the open-world story mode and uncover the secrets of the Metabrawl universe while honing your skills.

  • Powerful Fighters: Play as unique characters like Wolverinu, the ferocious brawler, or face off against fierce opponents such as Volt, Shiba, or Shibnobi.

  • Dynamic Arenas: Fight in beautifully crafted arenas that evolve during battles, pushing your tactics to the limit.

Are you ready to unleash your power and dominate the battlefield? The world of Metabrawl awaits!

Do you have what it takes to be the next metabrawl champion?

short_description: Metabrawl is a new way of action battles combined in platform fights, beat-em-up, open-world adventure to choose your favourite style. Explore the huge and dynamic world of meta-ryft without bounds.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i7-6700 or Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Radeon RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 6 GB available space
